notes: ACCESS: direct fetch worked throughout, no blocking. https://www.oka.com/uk 301s to https://www.oka.com/ (UK is the default locale, GBP), so canonical links use the bare www.oka.com/collections/ paths. Site is Shopify but the product grid is rendered entirely client-side by Graphene HC (Advanced Commerce): server HTML carries only 4 placeholder tiles and the 'Showing <n> of <N> items' header is empty until JS runs, so no count is readable from raw HTML or WebFetch. COUNT METHOD: located the grid's data source at POST https://okashopify-1.store-uk1.advancedcommerce.services/api/js/query (template id 'category', theme 38caf17c88c5431c932b42cdc117b64e). The collection is resolved server-side from the X-Referer header, not the body - without that header the API silently returns the whole 1637-product catalogue with header.category_id=null, which was a real trap. Every qty is elements.category.products.meta.product_count, the exact field the theme writes into the rendered [data-graphene-hc-el='pagination-total'] header. VERIFICATION: because the brief warns that reading the code proves only what the page renders, each count was also proved by exhaustion - paged the API with page_number until empty and counted unique item.id values. lighting 198 (60/60/60/18 then page 5 empty), mirrors 34, lampshades 76, table-lamps 74, tableware 116, homeware-accessories 242 - all matched product_count exactly, and children were confirmed as proper subsets of parents by product-ID set comparison. CROSS-CHECK NOTE: Shopify /collections/<handle>/products.json enumerates HIGHER (mirrors 54 vs 34, lighting 270 vs 198, crockery 66 vs 49) because OKA sells each size/colour as its own Shopify product and Graphene collapses them into one grid tile via size_related_products. The rendered grid figure is the site's own reported number, so the Graphene figure is used - consistent with the standing rule that only the rendered header is authoritative. RULE 0 GAINS: 'Decorative Planters' (10) lives only under the Garden/outdoor branch and was included on product type; it is 100% contained in 'Vases and Plant Pots' (33) and both are kept with the overlap documented here. 'Fire Screens' (5) was kept after opening a product page - OKA's own PDP breadcrumb reads 'Decorative Screens and Fire Fenders', confirming a decorative accessory rather than seating (3 of 5 are fire fenders, 2 are folding screens). OKA has no lighting-by-room or bathroom/vanity mirror tree, so 0.1/0.3/0.4 had nothing further to add here. DOCUMENTED OVERLAPS (Rule 0.6): 'Serving Trays and Carriers' (13, under Tableware) is 12/13 contained in 'Serving Accessories' (28, under Accessories) - two genuine nav nodes under different parents, both emitted. 'Placemats and Coasters' (7) is 4/7 inside Serving Accessories. 'Crockery' (49) fully contains Plates (24), Bowls (18) and Cups and Mugs (5), so it is emitted as a nested parent grouping row rather than a leaf. EXCLUDED, with reasons: 'Crockery Sets' (/collections/crockery-dinner-sets) 301s to /collections/crockery - same listing, dropped. 'Lighting Bulbs and Accessories' (1 item, a Tala light bulb) - bulbs. 'Storage Accessories' (32) - mixed roll-up of decorative jars/pots with wastepaper bins, pedal bins, box files, baskets and a coat stand; storage/utility majority. 'Bar Accessories and Furniture' (56) - majority bar stools, drinks trolleys and cabinets (furniture) plus bar tools, with the trays/coasters already counted elsewhere. 'Garden Accessories' (72) and 'Outdoor Entertaining' (140) - occasion re-cuts mixing garden furniture, throws, faux plants and cutlery with items already counted. Room roll-ups Living Room (525), Dining Room (362), Bedroom (222), Study (286), Hallway (182), Garden (64) and Rooms (1399) - these are not room-organised nodes of an approved product type but whole-room supersets dominated by sofas, cushion covers and rugs (sampled titles to confirm), so dropped as mixed roll-ups, not because of the room word. Also excluded per the standing lists: Home Fragrance, Faux Flowers and Faux Plants and Trees, Wallpaper, Cutlery, Textiles/Throws/Cushions/Rugs, all Furniture and Garden Furniture, Gifts, Sale, New In, Back in Stock, Bestsellers and the 'Icons' brand-collection landing pages. CANDLES: 'Candles and Holders' (31) was kept after reading all 31 titles - 23 are candle holders, tealight holders and decorative lanterns; 8 are scented Odyssey Collection candles. Well under the majority-scented threshold that caused other nodes to be dropped, so the node is taken at its site-reported 31 and the mix is flagged on the row.
